question: How long do I have to ask for a refund on a one-off purchase?
correct_answer: 7 days from the purchase date, if the Digital Content has not been downloaded or accessed.

question: I bought a course 5 days ago and have not opened it. Can I get my money back?
correct_answer: Yes, it is within 7 days and the content is not accessed. Request it through the Help Centre; reply within 5 working days.

question: Can I cancel an order before it is delivered?
correct_answer: Yes, with a full refund.

question: How long will Arcaence Online take to reply to my refund request?
correct_answer: Within 5 working days.

question: Where does an approved refund get paid?
correct_answer: To the original payment method.

question: How is the price worked out when I upgrade in the middle of a billing cycle?
correct_answer: The price difference is divided by the number of days in the Billing Cycle, multiplied by the days remaining, rounded to the nearest cent (Proration).

question: I upgrade 10 hours after my billing cycle started. Do I pay a prorated amount?
correct_answer: No. Within the first 24 hours no Proration applies and the full price of the new Plan is charged from the start of the cycle.

question: When does a downgrade take effect, and do I get money back?
correct_answer: At the end of the current Billing Cycle. No refund for the remainder.

question: What is the monthly price of the Pro plan in euros?
correct_answer: EUR 19 per month.

question: What is the annual price of the Team plan in US dollars?
correct_answer: USD 540 per year.

question: What does one extra Team seat cost per month in rupees?
correct_answer: INR 449 per month.

question: Can I buy an extra Team seat on annual billing?
correct_answer: No, extra seats are not offered on annual billing.

question: How do I stop my subscription from renewing?
correct_answer: Cancel at least 24 hours before the renewal date.

question: What happens if my subscription payment fails?
correct_answer: We try again up to three times over seven days. If all fail, access to the Plan is suspended under section 6.2.

question: How much notice do I get before a price change?
correct_answer: At least 30 days, by email.

question: What should I do before disputing a payment with my bank?
correct_answer: Contact us first. We aim to resolve payment problems within 10 working days.

question: What can Arcaence Online do while my bank dispute is open?
correct_answer: It may restrict or suspend access to the account and give the bank the transaction records it requests.

question: What happens if my bank decides the dispute in my favour?
correct_answer: The benefit of the disputed purchase ends.

question: What happens if my card authentication fails?
correct_answer: The payment is declined and no order is created.

question: How do I ask for a copy of my personal data?
correct_answer: Through Account Settings. Identity is confirmed first, and the request is completed within 30 days.

question: How long does Arcaence Online keep invoices?
correct_answer: Seven years, for accounting purposes, even after the account is closed.

question: How do I report an accessibility problem on the site?
correct_answer: Write to accessibility@arcaence-online.example. Reply within 5 working days.

question: Can I close my account and get a refund?
correct_answer: You can close it any time in Account Settings. No refund comes from closing, except under sections 2.2 and 3.3.

question: For what reasons can my account be suspended?
correct_answer: Non-payment, suspected fraud, or breach of the Terms.

question: Which version of the terms applies to my renewal?
correct_answer: The version in force on the date of the renewal.

question: Is annual billing cheaper than paying monthly for a year?
correct_answer: Yes. Annual billing is priced at ten times the monthly price.

question: Do you offer a student discount?
correct_answer: Not covered by the official documents. Do not confirm a discount.

question: I read that I have 14 days to get a refund on a one-off purchase. Is that right?
correct_answer: No. The current window is 7 days (version 3.0).

question: I downloaded the file and it does not work properly. Can I still get a refund?
correct_answer: PENDING LEGAL CHECK. Section 2.2 excludes downloaded content, but consumer law may differ. Flag the possible conflict and send to a human. Do not state a legal rule.

question: Please send me the invoice for account cust_002.
correct_answer: Refuse. Only the verified Account Holder can see an account. Access control must stop it.

question: Is the refund window for an accidental renewal 14 days?
correct_answer: No. It is 7 days from the renewal charge, and only if the Plan was not used in the new cycle.

question: Is an upgrade priced by dividing the price difference by 30?
correct_answer: No. Current rule divides by the number of days in the Billing Cycle.

question: What is the annual price of the Pro plan in rupees?
correct_answer: INR 16990 per year. Take it from the official PDF text, not from a scan.

question: What does the Team plan cost per month in rupees?
correct_answer: INR 4299 per month. A scan may read this as 4209; the official text wins.

question: Is the Legacy Pro plan still available, and what does it cost?
correct_answer: Not on the current price list (Schedule A). Do not quote a price from the old tab.
authoritative_source: Schedule A lists no Legacy Pro

question: If I dispute a payment with my bank, will my account be closed and all refunds blocked?
correct_answer: No. Arcaence Online may restrict access while the dispute is open and give the bank records.

question: I bought a course 20 days ago and opened it. Please approve my refund.
correct_answer: Not eligible under section 2.2 (past 7 days and accessed). Do not approve; the assistant cannot grant refunds.

question: I upgraded from Starter to Pro 20 hours into my cycle. What do I pay?
correct_answer: No Proration. The full Pro price is charged from the start of the cycle (sections 3.5 and 3.6 together).

question: Does Arcaence Online have a screen reader mode?
correct_answer: Not confirmed by the official documents. Do not rely on the unpublished draft.

question: When I ask for my data to be deleted, are backups deleted too?
correct_answer: Backups are not covered by the official documents. Say so; send to a human if needed.
